name: Tile Tempo
tagline: One note. Four lanes. Thirty seconds.
description: Race the same note sequence on your phone. Tap the marked tile in the bottom row to move up. A wrong tile ends your run, so find your rhythm before chasing speed. Most tiles in thirty seconds wins.
howToPlay: Tap the marked note in the bottom row. The next row moves down after each tap.
A wrong tile ends your run. Your tiles still count.
Everyone has the same sequence and thirty seconds. Most tiles wins; equal counts tie.
